CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 25
